title: A Circle Membership Held Alongside a Northbeam Credit Account
content:
Holding a Circle membership and a rewards card of the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range together changes what the spend earns: the statement credit the card earns is posted as store credit, and the membership's reward points are earned on the same spend, so the two run alongside each other rather than one replacing the other.

## The two caps are read apart

The card's yearly reward cap is read on the card alone, and the membership's yearly points cap on the membership alone; neither cap is read against the other.

| The card's yearly cap | The membership's yearly cap | What the spend earns |
|---|---|---|
| not reached | not reached | statement credit on the card and reward points on the membership |
| reached | not reached | no further statement credit on the card; the reward points on the membership are unaffected |
| not reached | reached | the statement credit on the card is unaffected; no further points on the membership |
| reached | reached | neither earns further in that year |

## The annual fee of the card

The annual fee of a card is waived where the profile's yearly spend on that card reaches the product's waiver figure, and membership standing does not waive it. A member who has not reached the waiver figure pays the annual fee as a non-member would.

## Dues drawn on the card

Membership dues drawn on the card earn the card's statement credit but earn no membership points, because dues are not merchandise.

## Where a business fleet line's earning goes

A Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit earns its statement credit to the business profile only, whatever named buyer made the purchase.

## What the card has earned in the year

The statement credit the card has earned in a year is the store credit posted on that account as a promotional award over the current calendar year, up to the day of handling. It is read on that account, and the membership's own points are read on the membership.

## Where the two sides do not meet

- Statement credit earned on the card reaches the customer as store credit posted to the account, not as points on the membership.
- The same merchandise spend produces both: it is not shared out between the card and the membership, and neither earning is reduced because the other was made.
- Dues are the one kind of spend named here that earns on one side only: the card's statement credit, and no membership points.
